name: Hayama Yuka
source:
Extremely weak with liquor, and gets drunk with as much as a shot. Is stubborn when it comes to sexual matters, but when fawned on, she'll see to it through the end. 

Actually, she loved Junpei more than his brother. She wanted to forget about it as a thing of the past, but then...

[Translated from [url=http://www.appetite-game.com/apt_019.html#char]Official Site[/url]]
